aciklama:
A 500-year-old melody hidden in Hieronymus Bosch's The Garden of Earthly Delights (c. 1490–1510, Museo del Prado, Madrid). In 2014 a college student transcribed it and recorded it.

What do you think? Tell us in the comments 👇

Sources: Museo Nacional del Prado, The Garden of Earthly Delights; 2014 transcription by Amelia Hamrick (Oklahoma Christian University), widely reported (e.g. Smithsonian Magazine, Feb 2014).
